title: Track Guide Oran Park - Moto FF1600 Fixed iRacing

corners.label: T1
corners.braking: brake at dotted white line, 50% pressure
corners.line: turn in to curb on inside

corners.label: T2
corners.braking: brake at white line on outside, increase pressure at W line
corners.line: float out to white line, take apex at start, follow white curb
corners.exit: throttle on exit, use outside curve

corners.braking: brake at white Astro turf, 90-95% pressure, trail brake to curb
Start braking when going uphill, peak at 50%, trail brake to apex.
corners.line: Take some curb on the inside, apex in the middle.
corners.exit: Apply throttle as corner opens up, avoid sand.
corners.mistakes: Do not touch sand, it kills momentum.

corners.label: T6
corners.line: Get close to the curb on the inside, take full throttle.
corners.exit: Use curb on the outside to avoid grass.

corners.label: T9
corners.braking: Brake a car length before the red and yellow curb, 65%.
corners.line: Take all of the curb on the inside and white astro turf.
corners.exit: Apply throttle once on the curb.

corners.label: T9
corners.braking: 60% brake pressure, trail brake to inside curb
corners.exit: Apply throttle on inside curb, use some white astro turf
corners.mistakes: Using too much white astro turf might unsettle the car
Taking too much curb might unsettle the car
Taking too much curb might unsettle the car

corners.label: T12
corners.braking: 90% brake pressure, trail brake to inside curb
corners.line: Apex on inside curb with tire marks
corners.exit: Pick up throttle on apex, carry speed uphill

general_tips: turn one and two is a good overtaking corner
Carry more speed than you think on the uphill
Get a good exit for the longest straight on the track
Can go beyond white line on exit
